रामायण फिल्म में शूर्पणखा के रोल के लिए राकुल प्रीत सिंह की मेहनत देखकर आप भी तारीफ करेंगे! 🔥

अभिनेत्री राकुल प्रीत सिंह ने Instagram पर अपनी फिल्म Ramayana के सेट से कुछ खास BTS तस्वीरें शेयर की हैं।
फिल्म में शूर्पणखा का किरदार निभा रहीं राकुल ने इस सफर को अपने लिए बेहद खास और यादगार बताया है।
राकुल ने खुलासा किया कि उनका यह लुक तैयार करने में मेकअप और कॉस्ट्यूम टीम को हर दिन 4 घंटे लगते थे।
उन्होंने बड़े विजन के साथ फिल्म बनाने के लिए डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari और प्रोड्यूसर Namit Malhotra का शुक्रिया अदा किया।
Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi और Yash की इस भव्य फिल्म का हिस्सा बनने पर राकुल को एक भारतीय के तौर पर गर्व है। ✨🎬

क्या आप Ramayana में राकुल प्रीत सिंह का यह अवतार देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में बताइए! 💬

ctx.title: Rakul Preet Singh reveals it took 4 hours every day to transform into Surpanakha in Ramayana, thanks Namit Malhotra and Nitesh Tiwari
ctx.summary: Rakul Preet Singh plays Surpanakha in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Yash as Ravana.
ctx.text:
The most anticipated film of the year, Ramayana , has finally released in theatres. Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Nitesh Tiwari's film is an adaptation of Valmiki's epic and also draws from other sources of the story, including Tulsidas' Ramcharitmanas. Rakul Preet Singh stars as Surpanakha in the film. The actor has now shared a heartfelt note on the journey of the film and expressed gratitude towards the makers.
Taking to Instagram, Rakul shared BTS pics from the shoot. In one pic, she was seen getting her makeup done on the set, and in another, she stood in position on set as she got the cues for the scene. In the caption, Rakul shared that she has been eager to talk about the film for so long and finally the time has come. She said, “It has been such a special journey for me. It’s not every day that you get to be a part of a story that has been a part of our lives and culture for generations. To see Ramayana being brought to life on such a grand scale is truly something else. Being part of a story that means so much to our country, and seeing it come together on such a scale, makes this journey even more special.”
She also thanked the entire cast and crew, and added, “Thank you @iamnamitmalhotra and @niteshtiwari22 sir the visionaries who dreamt big and turned this vision a reality. Their hardwork and the desire to create something extraordinary from india to the world has been a very inspiring journey.”
Rakul gave a special shout out to her team and added, “@im__sal @aliyashaik28 and costumes team for creating my look... all the appreciation coming our way is their creativity and hardwork of getting me ready for 4 hours everyday. Feeling grateful and excited for everyone to experience this one! it’s not just a film. It’s a moment that makes me feel proud as an Indian.”
Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu (played by Ranbir Kapoor), and his battle against the asura king Ravana (played by Yash) after the latter abducts his wife, Sita (played by Sai Pallavi). Surpanakha is Ravana's sister. Her insult at the hands of Rama's brother Lakshman leads to the Rama-Ravana war.
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari. A sequel is scheduled for release in 2028.
